ashwin: Quick async status for Jetstream prefetch sprint — short pulse. PR needs review and we have a canary window tmrw. Main asks: owners listed, blockers, and a microbench.

laura: On it — I'll take ownership of the kv-warmup flake. Can you paste repro steps / logs?

ashwin: Repro is simple: run loadgen with --seq 512 --prefetch-ttl 10 and you see warmup misses. Example log line: `[prefetch] miss idx=42 ttl=9ms`. Also PR is feature/jetstream-prefetch-handshake, touches kernel handshake + kv_fetcher backoff.

laura: Got the branch. I'll triage after standup and try a quick patch to increase prefetch-ttl. Assigning myself to the PR for now. @mike can you please review the kernel handshake changes?

mike: I will review today. Heads up: handshake changes introduce an extra spin in hotpath — want to run a microbenchmark before we can canary.

yara: I can run microbench on canary infra. Which branch name again?

ashwin: Branch: feature/jetstream-prefetch-handshake. Microbench command: `tools/bench --scenario=hotpath-kv --iters=200` — paste the tail results here.

mike: Kicking that now. Preliminary numbers: baseline p95 ~4.8ms, branch p95 ~5.4ms (≈+12.5%). Need to see end-to-end under concurrent load to judge impact.

yara: I'll queue a 10% traffic canary tmrw and add tracing filters for kernel-lock-wait + kv-miss. ops-bot, can you schedule the deploy?

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature/jetstream-prefetch-handshake -> staging canary at 2025-03-18T11:00:00Z. CI: 12/12 passed. :white_check_mark:

ashwin: Thanks. Quick checklist for everyone: (1) laura — runbook for kv-warmup flake + quick mitigation, (2) mike — microbench signoff and threshold check, (3) yara — canary + dashboard alerts, (4) ben/eng-infra — perf diff tooling. If any step is a blocker, call it out.

laura: I'll produce a short runbook in ~2h and include a backout patch that bumps prefetch-ttl and adds extra logging. Happy to gate the canary if folks want.

mike: If p95 delta >12% after full load test I'll request revert. Otherwise I'll approve. :thumbsup:

yara: Added dashboard watches: watch-p95, kv-miss-rate, kernel-lock-wait. Created alert: `kv-miss-rate > 5% for 2m` -> page oncall.

ashwin: Also FYI: we depend on eng-infra for perf diff runs. @ben said he's OOO today but might help tomorrow morning.

ben: I can spare 30m tomorrow at 9:00am PT to run the perf diff and help interpret results.

ashwin: Great — thanks all. Final async plan: laura runbook + mitigation, mike microbench signoff, yara canary + alerts, ben perf diff. If no red flags by 10:30 PT tomorrow we proceed with the 11:00Z canary. Ping here for any urgent changes. End of thread.
